basis: The admitted immutable-runtime contract requires stale/drifted producer refusal. A current source fingerprint plus valid old compiled-release digest does not prove those outputs were built from current source.
operations: Root package.json build script calls only the fixed product-owned tools/veyviz-build.mjs. No dependencies or package-lock change is needed for a script-only change.
The wrapper uses one shared reusable authored-build-input capture in tools/veyviz-inventory.mjs. Existing release-inventory v1 capture/verify behavior remains compatible.

Capture exact authored input path/length/hash inventory and admitted Node/compiler/bundler toolchain identity before spawn. Retain the executing wrapper, inventory helper and fixed core builder bytes in that identity.
Before spawning the fixed tools/build.mjs child, retire the current qualification pointer into unique history. Never leave a prior current receipt eligible after an unsuccessful build attempt.

Spawn only process.execPath plus the fixed tools/build.mjs path, shell disabled, explicit producer CWD and hidden Windows window. Observe the original child close, preserve spawn errors and raw output, and admit success only with code 0 and null signal.

After successful original close, repeat authored input/toolchain capture and require exact equality. Verify both existing Veyviz release identities and complete admitted export inventories using existing composition APIs. Capture exact post-build release identities and selected expectedFactoryInventory digests, including the generated root tsconfig bytes as an output identity.

Publish a bounded physical receipt atomically only after all checks. Bind exact inputs, toolchain, original build outcome, verified releases and factory-input digests. Keep attempt evidence and prior receipt history on every failure; no fallback receipt or checkout runtime.

The snapshot helper verifies the current qualification receipt and current source/toolchain/release/export identities before assembly or selection reuse, then repeats receipt verification after factory preparation and before enrollment. Receipt digest joins deterministic candidate and launch identities.

Current receipt labels/digests are local reported provenance, not authenticated execution or production acceptance. Runtime fixed-byte integrity remains independently checked by the existing snapshot/copy verifiers.

sharedInputCapture.reuse: Refactor the existing inventory path discovery once; do not duplicate source roots in the build and snapshot helpers.
sharedInputCapture.authoredInputs: Existing SOURCE_ROOTS and authored ROOT_FILES, plus exact visual/studio.js and visual/studio.css read by the core visual build. Include all workspace src, manifests, tsconfigs, solution wiring, module/product definitions, tools, tests, templates, profiles, package-lock and tsconfig.base.
sharedInputCapture.rootTsconfig: Core tools/build.mjs derives and rewrites root tsconfig.json; exclude it from pre/post authored equality and bind its actual post-build bytes as an output. Never exclude per-workspace authored tsconfig files.
sharedInputCapture.toolchain: Bind actual executing Node identity and the installed TypeScript/esbuild package/version and executed tooling bytes to the captured lockfile. A path/version label alone does not detect changed executable tooling. Do not change global configuration or install external tooling.
sharedInputCapture.bounds: Use explicit finite file-count/path/per-file/total-byte/serialized-receipt limits above the observed source closure, enforce physical regular files and paths, reject duplicates/links/unknown receipt fields, and compare exact paths, lengths and hashes. Node binary may need a separately declared larger per-file toolchain bound.
sharedInputCapture.companion: Build-input capture must not require unavailable private model/profile files for catalog compilation. Existing external profile/inventory verification and launcher companion fingerprints remain separate.

meaningfulRegressions: Missing receipt refuses before credentials, enrollment and runtime fork.
After a valid qualified build, modify selected module src TS while retaining old dist/release; start refuses before enrollment/fork. Restore bytes and receipt verification matches again.
Modify or omit compiled output, release identity, receipt identity/input inventory, or actual tooling; refuse before enrollment/fork.
Nonzero/spawn-error/signal build attempt leaves no current qualified receipt and preserves original attempt output/close facts. Input drift during fixed build likewise cannot publish qualification.

Perform a real explicit wrapper build after a valid authored profile/export input change, then prove a new verified snapshot/fingerprint/data generation. No direct receipt forging or mocked snapshot verifier supplies success.
Unchanged wrapper build and unchanged inputs preserve selected full snapshot digest and data fingerprint. A random receipt attempt ID/time must not rotate launch identity.
Keep actual fixed catalog HTTP bytes, backend row/revoked grant restart, IPC/occupied-port original closure and tamper/inventory/escape tests. Record filesystem blocks without weakening security.
limits: This proposes three added owners; root must admit the amendment and reconcile Brain/atlas before implementation.

Receipt successful-build provenance is locally reported and cannot authenticate a hostile writer's execution claim. Exact current input/output checks prevent accidental stale reuse; this is not a third-party trust or sandbox boundary.

The wrapper reuses the maintained builder; it does not assert a new compiler correctness or arbitrary source-to-dist proof. Qualification must freshly construct the isolated source overlay and retain raw original close evidence.
No source, Brain, dependency, build, test, process or browser mutation was performed by the reviewer. Only this ignored review artifact was written.
Whole-product npm/Python/browser/model/adoption/production qualification remains separate. Historical original child close and foreign process/data impact remain UNKNOWN.
proposedRootRecords: Admit the exact three-owner addition only after reviewing this proposal; record enforceable source/build receipt verification as part of the immutable-runtime contract, preserve all failed attempts, and keep product acceptance unbound until actual final qualification.

admission.authority: Existing human fix all; concrete independent review found stale authored source could select old compiled outputs despite the explicit refusal requirement.
admission.coordination: Source-only implementation while framework full suite runs; all product build/tests later in explicitly addressed isolated overlay. Preserve all foreign source/process/data and failed evidence.
